about: A dungeon-crawl text adventure: you are told to seek a silver-haired old man when worthy, then explore dark passages, a stuck Elvish sword, a misty barren land, and an underground sea.

done.why: A few minutes of walking through similar empty shadowy hills with no goal or puzzle in reach. Nothing grabbed me.

moments.note: Walking south in the dark gave a grue warning, a classic touch.
The sword is stuck in the rock with no hint why.
Quicksand blocked the way and the hills all felt alike.

wished: A clear goal or a hint where to find the old man

lines.line: Seek me when you feel yourself worthy!
lines.why: The only hook toward a goal, and it was vague.

engagement.why: No hook strong enough to keep going.

difficulty.why: Unclear what to do, so direction was missing.

interestingness.why: Intriguing setting (underground sea, Elvish sword) but little to interact with.
